title: Discourse Map
description: Structured output of the global discourse pass for a chapter. Anchored at chapter level. Establishes the discourse framework — QUDs, argument structure, boundaries, relational dynamics — that grounds the verse-level analyses.

dominant_quds.description: The dominant Questions Under Discussion active across this chapter. These are the implicit or explicit issues the discourse is building toward or answering.

argument_structure.description: Prose description of the argumentative, narrative, or poetic arc of the chapter.

verse_start.description: First verse of this discourse unit.

verse_end.description: Last verse of this discourse unit.

description.description: What this discourse unit is doing — its function in the chapter's argument or narrative.

discourse_boundaries.description: Discourse units with verse ranges and functional descriptions. Boundaries are identified from structure, QUD shifts, topic changes, or genre markers.

relational_dynamics.description: The social and relational context operative across the chapter: speaker-addressee relationship, power/solidarity balance, face considerations, and how these shift.

active_scales.description: Scalar dimensions active in this chapter (e.g. obligation/permission, honor/shame, affection/distance). These are the scales whose endpoints matter for pragmatic interpretation.

key_presuppositions.description: Background assumptions the chapter takes for granted — propositions that are presupposed rather than asserted and that ground the discourse.

genre_notes.description: Genre and register observations affecting interpretation: what kind of text this is, what norms govern it, and how that shapes pragmatic expectations.
